ledgersettings.name: ledger settings
ledgersettings.intro: Double-entry ledger: who may read and post, and the size limits of one entry. Amounts are integer minor units.
ledgersettings.loadError: We could not load ledger settings.
ledgersettings.summary: Entries are append-only. Each transaction balances to zero per currency.

currencysettings.name: currency settings
currencysettings.intro: Currencies, rounding and optional static tax rates (basis points).
currencysettings.loadError: We could not load currency settings.
currencysettings.summary: Half even rounds 2.5 to 2 and 3.5 to 4. Invoices use this currency list. Booking cancellation has its own currency.

reconsettings.name: reconciliation settings
reconsettings.intro: Who may read and run statement reconciliation, the matching tolerance and the statement size cap.
reconsettings.loadError: We could not load reconciliation settings.
reconsettings.summary: Import a statement, match lines against one ledger account and close the run. A one-minor-unit difference fits any tolerance of one or more.

invoicingsettings.name: invoicing settings
invoicingsettings.intro: Invoice numbering, payment terms, ledger accounts, aging buckets and optional payouts.
invoicingsettings.loadError: We could not load invoicing settings.
invoicingsettings.summary: Invoices post to the mapped ledger accounts. Aging buckets group overdue balances by day count.

bookingsettings.name: booking settings
bookingsettings.intro: Bookable kinds (slots, ranges, pools), hold time, horizon, cancellation and who may read, book and manage.
bookingsettings.loadError: We could not load booking settings.
bookingsettings.summary: A new booking starts as a hold and expires at the configured hold time unless confirmed. The cancellation fee is recorded in the booking.

geosettings.name: geo settings
geosettings.intro: Places and geofences: who may read and write, the size limits and the index cell size. Distances and coordinates use integer metres and micro-degrees. The provider is always the built-in fake one.
geosettings.loadError: We could not load geo settings.
geosettings.summary: The built-in fake geocoder, routing and ETA are deterministic and make no outbound calls.

locationsettings.name: location settings
locationsettings.intro: Live positions: who may read and report, how many history rows are kept per subject and how many subjects are tracked.
locationsettings.loadError: We could not load location settings.
locationsettings.summary: A newer sequence updates the latest position and trims older history. Reports with an equal or older sequence are ignored.

connectC.offHelp: The spec has no settings for it, so nothing is generated. Switching it on saves the default settings, which you can then edit.
connectC.switchOffHelp: Remove these settings from the spec? Other packs are not touched.
connectC.conflict: Someone else changed the packs since you opened them. All pack settings share one version. Reload to see the latest settings and discard your unsaved changes.
connectC.reviewHelp: Review the effect of these changes before saving.
connectC.roleHelp: An empty list allows any signed-in user.
connectC.manageHelp: Choose at least one manager. An empty list opens manager routes to signed-in users and gives nobody manager status.
connectC.managerChange: Any signed-in user could call manager routes. Nobody would have manager status for booking visibility.
connectC.gridChange: Existing places keep their stored grid cells. Radius queries may miss them until stored places are re-indexed.
connectC.retentionChange: The lower history cap trims older rows per subject when a newer position arrives after regeneration.
connectC.ledgerNeedsCurrency: Ledger settings depend on the currency list.
connectC.reconNeedsCurrency: Reconciliation settings depend on the currency list.
connectC.invoiceNeedsCurrency: Invoicing settings depend on the currency list.
connectC.reconDepends: Reconciliation settings depend on the ledger.
connectC.invoiceDepends: Invoicing settings and payouts depend on the ledger.
connectC.geoDepends: New positions will stop evaluating geofences after regeneration.
connectC.locationDepends: Matching uses live positions. Review matching settings before switching off.
connectC.payoutsRemoved: This also removes the payout settings.
connectC.bookingRemoved: This removes all {{count}} saved bookable kinds and the cancellation settings.
connectC.bookingOnHint: After switching on, declare at least one resource kind.

help.rounding: Half even (banker’s rounding) is the supported mode.
help.rates_bp: Use a JSON object with up to 50 lowercase names and integer rates from 0 to 10,000 basis points, for example {"vat": 2000}.
help.tolerance_minor: Minor units. The current ceiling is {{ceiling}}.
help.number_prefix: Up to 12 letters, digits, hyphens, underscores or slashes.
help.aging_buckets_days: Enter 1 to 8 strictly increasing day counts, separated by commas. Each count is 1 to 3,650.
help.timezone: Choose or enter an IANA time zone.
help.mode: Changing the mode clears fields the new mode cannot use.
help.name: Start with a lowercase letter. Use up to 40 lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
help.hold_ttl_seconds: Seconds until an unconfirmed hold expires.
help.max_horizon_days: Days in advance that a booking can be made.
help.currency: Use three uppercase letters. Booking uses its own currency setting.
help.own_only: Managers can see all bookings. Other users see only their own when this is on.
help.schedule: Use a JSON object with weekday arrays, for example {"mon":[{"start":"09:00","end":"17:00"}]}.

connectC.accountsHelp: Use distinct ledger account codes. For each additional currency, suffix the account code with a period and the currency code.
connectC.matchingHelp: The generated app considers up to 5,000 ledger entries per run. Set period_start and period_end to narrow larger accounts.
connectC.indexHelp: Changing the grid size after places exist requires re-indexing their stored cells. Radius queries scan up to 5,000 rows and can return truncated results.
connectC.retentionHelp: When a newer position arrives, the generated app deletes older history rows beyond the cap.
connectC.removeCurrencyHelp: This takes the currency out of the accepted list when you save.
connectC.invalidWeekdayHelp: Use the JSON editor to correct unsupported weekday keys.
connectC.payoutsOn: Payouts split the seller share and a platform commission of {{value}} basis points.
connectC.geofencesOn: New positions are evaluated against configured geofences.
connectC.geofencesOff: Enable Geo settings to evaluate new positions against geofences.

validation.range: {{field}} must be a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
validation.unsupportedCurrency: {{code}} is not a supported currency code.
validation.taxName: Use a lowercase identifier for the tax rate {{name}}.
validation.taxRate: The tax rate {{name}} must be a whole number from 0 to 10,000 basis points.
validation.invoicePrefix: Use up to 12 letters, digits, hyphens, underscores or slashes.
validation.accountCode: Start with a letter or digit. Use up to 40 letters, digits, periods, underscores, colons or hyphens.
validation.distinctAccounts: Use a distinct code for each ledger account.
validation.agingDays: Enter 1 to 8 strictly increasing whole day counts from 1 to 3,650.
validation.bookingCurrency: Enter a three-letter uppercase currency code.
validation.kindName: Start with a lowercase letter. Use up to 40 lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
validation.duplicateKind: Each resource kind needs a different name.
validation.timezone: Enter an IANA time zone such as Asia/Kolkata or UTC.
validation.scheduleShape: Enter a JSON object with weekday arrays of start and end times.
validation.openingWindow: A slot kind needs at least one opening window.
validation.weekday: {{day}} is not a weekday key. Use mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat or sun.
validation.windowTime: {{day}} window {{index}} needs an end after its start, with both times in HH:MM.
validation.windowLength: {{day}} window {{index}} must fit at least one slot.
validation.windowOverlap: Opening windows on {{day}} must not overlap.
validation.durationOrder: Max minutes must be at least Min minutes.
